AdminCSRF.description: Management writes also require matching same-origin Origin. Session endpoints return the CSRF token.
AdminCSRF.name: X-CSRF-Token

AdminSession.description: HttpOnly SameSite=Strict 30-minute session. A browser signs in with the administrator password (POST /api/v1/admin/login); the management token only starts a first-time session that may do nothing but set the password. A script exchanges a management token without an Origin header and keeps full access; revoking or replacing the token ends that session. Setting, changing or resetting the password ends every password session.
AdminSession.name: deskhub_session

DeviceBearer.description: Independent revocable per-device credential, issued through the local management tool. Scopes and target permissions are checked on every business request.

info.description: DeskHub protocol v1.0; Agent and firmware versions are separate. Device business endpoints require per-device Bearer credentials; /api/v1/admin uses an independently authenticated cookie session and CSRF-protected same-origin writes. LAN traffic requires TLS and configured network access. Command bodies are limited to 4096 bytes, snapshots to 16384 bytes. sent_at is required to enforce a maximum 5 second client clock skew. expires_at defaults to sent_at + 10 seconds, and validity cannot exceed 30 seconds. Identical retries use the original device identity, idempotency_key, timestamps and payload. Use GET /api/v1/commands?idempotency_key=... to recover a lost submission response. A zero backend exit code alone cannot produce succeeded. A succeeded display command requires matching readback; a lost control path produces unconfirmed. Current 0.2 development firmware management configuration uses schema 1 with default layout.theme=mint and display.rotation=0; omitted additive fields are normalized before revision ACK comparison. This does not claim management, themes or rotation support for 0.1 firmware.
info.title: DeskHub Agent

requestBody.description: Signed app-only ZIP, at most 7 MiB; independently trusted P-256 signature, board/chip/schema, image size/hash/version all verified before retention.
